propositions: SKILL.md lacks a Step 0 section before Phase 1 to search the tracker for existing bug reports and establish which build the bug was reported against.
The skill mandates a fresh worktree from origin/main but provides no gate to detect stale trees or to establish a reported-against version floor from ticket creation time or description.
The only tracker-search guidance in SKILL.md is advisory text about prior fixes inside Phase 1, not a mandatory step, and does not record whether to link duplicates or resume an existing ticket.

The ticket_state.schema.json has no rebar-version field; the reported-against version must be derived from report text or ticket created_at (in nanoseconds) converted to unix-seconds for git commands.
Step 0's duplicates link action must be added to the approval-gate carve-out to avoid requiring user approval for an own-tracker writeback mandated by the skill.
A unit test must pin that Step 0 exists before Phase 1, names all three actions, states the nanosecond-to-seconds conversion explicitly in the runnable command, and records the unknown-version case.
